svg.aria-label: Three real-world uses of P2P. File sharing with BitTorrent: Peers A to D find each other through a tracker or DHT and exchange file pieces directly. Blockchain networks such as Bitcoin, Ethereum and other decentralized ledgers: Nodes A to E share blocks with every other node, and many full nodes keep a complete copy of the ledger. Decentralized storage such as IPFS, Filecoin and Storj: a file is split into chunks spread across Peers A to D, with redundancy through replicas or erasure coding, which Storj uses
svg.text: Peers discover each other through a tracker or DHT and share file pieces directly.
Many full nodes keep a complete copy of the ledger and share blocks with other peers.
Files are split into chunks spread across many peers, with redundancy through replicas or erasure coding.
